row.evidence: Vimeo's pricing page lists "SSO (SAML) and SCIM (OKTA, AZURE)" only under Enterprise, and the help centre says Enterprise accounts with SSO enabled can use SCIM; Enterprise is sold through sales only.
row.notes: SCIM and SAML SSO are Enterprise-only (Contact Sales); Starter $12, Standard $25, Advanced $75 per seat/mo billed annually ($20 monthly for Starter). SSO must be enabled first, SCIM must be switched on by Vimeo's success team, and the token is a Vimeo API token with SCIM scopes generated by the account owner. Okta and Entra are configured as generic SCIM 2.0 against https://api.vimeo.com/scim/v2/{owner user ID}; the only OIN listing is a third-party Redblock connector. JumpCloud documents a SCIM connector. Audit logs (CSV/API) are Enterprise-only. Vimeo's developer API reference could not be read (client-rendered, blocks headless rendering), so the user API is left null.

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: $12 per seat / month billed annually ($20 monthly)

auth.token_source: developer.vimeo.com > New app > Generate an access token > Authenticated (you) > Private > SCIM scopes (account owner only)

deprovision.notes: The SCIM setup article says the account is deactivated and stops using a seat; the provisioning-types article says the user is removed from the Vimeo account.

attributes.notes: Vimeo says it does not support all SCIM out-of-the-box user attributes; userName must equal the email.

roles.how: A single SSO-settings 'Default role' is applied to all users created via JIT or SCIM; no per-user role attribute is documented.

limitations.text: SCIM must be enabled by Vimeo's success team on the Enterprise account; only the account owner can set it up and generate the token.
Existing Vimeo users whose email domain is not claimed must accept a verification email and stay 'Pending' until they do.
Provisioning fails when the account reaches its seat cap.
In Okta, users already assigned to the SAML app before provisioning is enabled are not provisioned automatically.
Only SCIM 2.0 is supported; SCIM 1.1 is not.

okta.notes: The only OIN listing for Vimeo is Redblock's agentic lifecycle connector, which says it works 'without native SCIM'. Vimeo's own guide adds SCIM provisioning to a customer's existing Okta SAML app (generic SCIM).

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial for Vimeo was found (vimeo-tutorial and vimeo-provisioning-tutorial return 404); Vimeo's own guide configures an Entra enterprise app with the Vimeo SCIM tenant URL.

open_questions: Vimeo's developer API reference (developer.vimeo.com/api/reference/teams) is client-rendered and could not be read, so team/user-management endpoints and plan gating of the API are unconfirmed.
Whether SCIM deprovisioning deactivates or removes the member, and whether it ends sessions, is not stated consistently.
SCIM delete, PUT/PATCH semantics, filtering, pagination and discovery endpoints are not documented.
No Entra gallery app, Google Workspace or OneLogin catalogue entry for Vimeo was confirmed.
